data.outcome_summary: This OECD TALIS 2024: Albania results note summarizes self-reported information from lower secondary teachers and principals collected in 2024. It reports descriptive indicators (e.g., teacher age and gender composition, experience profiles, perceived ability to adapt teaching to diversity, confidence in social and emotional learning instruction, and technology/AI use) and highlights only statistically significant differences or changes compared with the OECD average. The document cautions that cross-country comparisons should be interpreted carefully because TALIS relies solely on self-reports and may be shaped by social and cultural context. It also flags that some estimates may be affected by non-response bias (e.g., for certain figures). No student achievement outcomes, plausible values, or ML prediction models are analyzed in this note; instead, it functions as an evidence briefing for education policy discussion.
